// matching helpers
function longestCommonSubstring(a: string, b: string): number {
  let best = 0
  const dp = Array.from({length: a.length+1}, () => new Array(b.length+1).fill(0))
  for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) {
      if (a[i-1] === b[j-1]) { dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1; if (dp[i][j] > best) best = dp[i][j] }
    }
  }
  return best
}

function matchIssueId(where: string): string {
  let best: { id: string; score: number } | null = null
  for (const issue of data.issues) {
    const samePlace = where === issue.location || where.includes(issue.location) || issue.location.includes(where)

    if (score < 0) continue
    if (!best || score > best.score || (score === best.score && issue.id.localeCompare(best.id) < 0)) {
      best = { id: issue.id, score }
    }
  }
  return best ? best.id : ""
}
